title: Improve CSGBox, CSGCylinder and CSGTorus UVs and add UV and material customisation properties
body: Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14133 Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/111997 Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/937 Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12745 - Add `scale_uv` property to `CSGBox`, `CSGCylinder` and `CSGTorus`. `scale_uv` scales the uvs of the mesh to maintain uniform texel size, aimed at prototyping without a triplanar material. - Add `flip_uvs` property and `FlipUVMode` enum to `CSGPrimitive3D`. When using a `CSGCombiner` or flipping faces, the UVs can end up mirrored, `flip_uvs` fixes this issue by mirroring the UVs. FlipUVMode allows selecting between X, Y and Both axes. Works with `CSGCylinder`, `CSGBox`, `CSGSphere` and `CSGTorus`. On CSGMesh and CSGPolygon the option is not displayed. - Add `uv_size` property to `CSGBox`, `CSGCylinder` and `CSGTorus`. `uv_size` can be used to change the texel size of the mesh. - Add `top_material` and `bottom_material` properties to `CSGBox` and `CSGCylinder`. When set, they change the top and/or bottom faces of CSGBox or CSGCylinder. # CSGBox - `scale_uv`: Enabling this will scale the UVs to account for `CSGBox` `size`, maintaining uniform texel size. scale_uv off scale_uv on - `uv_offset`: offsets the UVs of the CSGBox. - `uv_size`: scales the UVs of the CSGBox. - `uv_floor_rotation` allows rotating the top and bottom faces of a CSGBox in 90º degree intervals. - `compatibility_mode`: the current and previous versions of godot used an algorithm to procedurally generate a manifold Box mesh. This resulted in the UVs pointing in different directions. Since this used a `face_count` of `12`, it would always generate the same cube with 6 faces. So I ran the generation code in a small C++ program and produced the result of the generation, then created a variation with the side faces aligned in the Y axis and the top and bottom faces aligned in the Z axis. Enabling `compatibility_mode `replicates the look of CSGBox in previous versions of godot. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8db3e099-a5ef-4d55-93d8-d3b6ffac947d - `top_material`: when set, changes the top face of CSGBox. useful for roofs or ceilings. When null, uses the `base_material`, making it compatible with existing projects. - `bottom_material`: when set, changes the bottom face of CSGBox. usefull for floors. When null, uses the `base_material`, making it compatible with existing projects. # CSGCylinder - CSGCylinder had rough UV generation. With permission from @Calinou , I fixed the UVs. The side faces are now evenly sized and distributed, while the top and bottom faces can tile a texture. - `scale_uv`: enabling this will scale the top and bottom faces with respect to the cylinder's `radius`. The side faces on the other hand will scale vertically with the cylinder's `height`, and increase or decrease the number of horizontal "repetitions" with respect to `radius`. The cylinder will always scale in a way that perfectly wraps a whole number of faces around the cylinder. - `uv_size`: scales the UVs of the CSGCylinder. the top and bottom faces are scaled, while the side faces are only scaled in the Y axis, as the horizontal scale is controlled by horizontal_divisions. - `uv_horizontal_divisions`: The number of times the texture on the `CSGCylinder `is going to repeat horizontally (this works with and without `scale_uv`). Default is 4. When scale_uv is enabled, this is used to calculate the number of horizontal repetitions on a cylinder with a 1m radius. Increasing the radius will increase the repetitions, while reducing it will reduce the number of repetitions. - `uv_offset`: Offsets the UVs on the side faces of the CSGCylinder. - `top_uv_offset`: Offsets the UVs on the top and bottom faces of the CSGCylinder. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a67d499d-9305-4965-b9be-8be8f8f19a99 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6b57aa9c-0518-4178-ac65-a02b72b0175e - `top_material`: when set, changes the top face of CSGCylinder. useful for roofs or ceilings. When null, uses the `base_material`, making it compatible with existing projects. - `bottom_material`: when set, changes the bottom face of CSGCylinder. usefull for floors. When null, uses the `base_material`, making it compatible with existing projects. # CSGTorus - CSGTorus had the same UV issues as CSGCylinder. This PR fixes the UVs. - `scale_uv`: enabling this will increase or decrease the number of horizontal and vertical "repetitions" with respect to `radius` (calculated from inner radius and outer radius). The torus will always scale in a way that perfectly wraps a whole number of faces. - `uv_size`: scales the UVs of the CSGTorus. - `uv_horizontal_divisions`: The number of times the texture on the `CSGTorus` is going to repeat horizontally (this works with and without `scale_uv`). Default is 8. When scale_uv is enabled, this is used to calculate the number of horizontal repetitions based on radius. Increasing the radius will increase the repetitions, while reducing it will reduce the number of repetitions. - `uv_vertical_divisions`: The number of times the texture on the `CSGTorus` is going to repeat "vertically" (this works with and without `scale_uv`). Default is 4. When scale_uv is enabled, this is used to calculate the number of horizontal repetitions based on radius. Increasing the radius will increase the repetitions, while reducing it will reduce the number of repetitions. - `uv_offset`: Offsets the UVs on the faces of the CSGTorus.
